text.p: Tropical cyclone Drena is weakening as it moves rapidly away from New Caledonia. The conditions across the island should improve, however flooding continues for another day or two. Drena will now threaten mostly shipping during the next 12-24 hours as it begins to become extratropical. It should be an extratropical storm as it tracks into New Zealand later in the period. It will still have gusty winds and heavy rain when it moves into New Zealand. It will affect shipping in the area and will also cause some flooding and wind damage.

Winds associated with tropical cyclone Rachel have diminished and are no longer considered significant. Locally heavy rains could still lead to flooding over portions of West Australia during today and Thursday.

Tropical Cyclone Fabriola, with 40 mph winds, is over southern Madagascar and dissipating. Heavy rains continue to result in flash flooding across the mountainous terrain of southern Madagascar. Conditions will improve over the next couple days as the storm dissipates.
